channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Child neglect accused who fled UK still at large NINE months after warrant request
item.description: A woman who fled the UK while facing charges of child neglect is still at large in Spain, despite an attempt to extradite her being launched NINE months ago.

item.title: Norwich company treating age-related eye diseases agrees '$1bn deal' with global firm
item.description: Ikarovec, based at Norwich Research Park, has agreed a partnership with VectorBuilder to develop treatments for age-related eye diseases - a deal that could be worth more than $1 billion.

item.title: Ten Norwich scientists named among world’s most highly cited researchers
item.description: Ten scientists at Norwich Research Park have been named among the world’s most highly cited researchers in Clarivate's Highly Cited Researchers list 2025.

item.title: City centre coffee shop and deli goes into liquidation
item.description: A business in one of the city's poshest streets has entered liquidation as its owner says "it's time to call it a day".

item.title: Man admits causing death of popular swimming coach in city crash
item.description: A motorist has admitted causing the death of a popular swimming coach in a crash on a busy road in Norwich.

item.title: Dilapidated former city pub one step closer to being turned into homes
item.description: New proposals reducing the number of homes to be built at 25 Cattle Market Street, Norwich, from five townhouses to three have been approved.

item.title: Discovery of large haul of cocaine sees man accused of supply
item.description: Xhemal Rricku pleaded not guilty to cocaine and cannabis charges at Norwich Magistrates' Court.

item.title: Norfolk construction worker's 'pee patches' go viral gaining millions of views online
item.description: Thetford construction worker Sheldon Weinman's Pee Patch business has sold products worldwide and gained millions of views on social media.

item.title: One of region's largest housebuilders appoints new managing director for East Anglia
item.description: Lovell has appointed Matthew Goakes as its new regional managing director for East Anglia as Simon Medler moves into two new roles.

item.title: Norfolk carnival reverts to original parade route after road rage drama
item.description: Cromer Carnival parade will revert back to its previous route after road rage incidents saw it re-routed last year in a trial.
